lessons: `Message` in squatch/box.py has no `bug_origin` or `has_repro` field, so `starting_state` cannot get these values for a `bug_report` message. Guessing them from the free-form `origin` makes every bug_report item raise ValueError after a paid LLM call.
squatch/git.py only lists untracked files (`ls-files --others`). It has no public op for tracked files. Calling `Git._run("ls-files")` from author.py skips the named-op rule and hides a scope escape.

The plan or ticket needs fixing: add squatch/box.py (a bug_origin/has_repro source on the message, or a defined mapping) and squatch/git.py plus tests/test_git.py (a named `ls_files` op) to the fence. Then regenerate the ticket.

Once the fence is fixed, keep the current diff. Check that the starting-state inputs resolve before `driver.run`, so an item that cannot be resolved makes no LLM call and stays pending with its author verdict.
When a needed change falls outside the fence, answer premise_failed as the Definition of rejected says. Do not work around it with private APIs or guessed mappings.
